model_scope: Reduced 8-period discrete two-point latent defect model; one outstanding report at a time; same actions for all policies; NOT the original 12-period F7.1 simulator
limitations: Model is intentionally small; not a full-scale oracle
Greedy/fixed are heuristic baselines; not established state-of-art algorithms
Prior-expected optimality does not guarantee conditional dominance for fixed true defect rates
Reporting queue restricts to one outstanding batch and forbids production while reports pending
